outputs.explanation: Panel A is a sequence conservation logo, not a plot of averaged data.
Bar/scatter plot of inhibition zone percentages shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots overlaid, as stated in the caption and visible in the figure.
Panel C consists of epifluorescence micrographs, not a quantitative plot of averages.
Scatter plot of fluorescence intensity shows mean ± SEM with individual yellow open-circle data points from individual cells.
Scatter plot of fluorescence intensity (log scale) shows mean ± SEM with individual blue open-circle data points from individual cells.
Panel F shows super-resolution PALM localization images of representative cells, not an averaged quantification plot.
Scatter plot of number of clusters per cell shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cell.
Scatter plot of cluster sizes (log scale) shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cluster.
Scatter plot of percentage of molecules in clusters shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cell.
